story:
Ethan and the Lost Dino Rex

[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan loved sunny afternoons at the park. [emotion:QT/happy] He carried his favorite toy, a *bright* green dinosaur named Rex, in his hand. Rex had *sharp* teeth and a *long*, *spiky* tail. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan was excited to play with his friend, Leo, who was already waiting near the *tall* oak tree.

[gesture:hi] "Hi, Leo!" Ethan called, walking quickly over the *soft* grass.
[gesture:hi] [emotion:QT/happy] "Hi, Ethan! Are you ready for our dinosaur adventure?" Leo asked, smiling.
[emotion:QT/happy] "Yes! Rex wants to explore the *grassy* hills," Ethan said, holding up his toy.
They decided to build a *secret* dinosaur hideout *behind* the big slide. Ethan carefully placed Rex *next to* a *smooth*, gray rock. Then, they gathered *flat* leaves and *bumpy* sticks to make a roof.

When they finished, [emotion:QT/surprised] Rex was gone! Ethan looked *under* the leaves. [emotion:QT/afraid] "Where did Rex go?" he asked, feeling a little *worried*.
[emotion:QT/calm] Leo patted Ethan's shoulder. "Don't worry, Ethan. We can search together. Let's look carefully *around* this area first."
[emotion:QT/calm] "Okay," Ethan agreed. Leo looked *near* the fence, and Ethan looked *behind* the bushes.
"I found a *tiny* feather!" Leo said, picking it up. "But not Rex."
Ethan peered *into* a *dark* tunnel made of branches. [emotion:QT/afraid] "Maybe he *ran* away because he was scared of the tunnel," Ethan suggested, using his *brave* voice.
"That's a good idea, Ethan," Leo responded. "Let's check *inside* it."
They both crawled into the tunnel. It was a *little* dusty, and they saw a *small* spider web.
[emotion:QT/surprised] "Look!" Ethan exclaimed, pointing his finger. *Under* a big, *round* stone, Rex was waiting!
[emotion:QT/happy] "You found him! Rex just wanted to hide because he thought it was a *perfect* spot," Leo said, carefully picking up the dinosaur.
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt so *relieved* and *grateful*. "Thank you for helping me, Leo!"
[emotion:QT/happy] "Of course, Ethan! Friends help each other," Leo replied. [emotion:QT/happy] They spent the rest of the afternoon playing happily, making Rex fly over the *wavy* grass.

It's okay to feel worried, and talking about it can help.
